$comment: Design adequacy table (detector system design spec ADQ-01..ADQ-07, contracts 3.11.0): per figure of merit, the nature of the F1 result, the screening and compliance fidelity thresholds, the minimum relative uncertainty of an estimate, the one-sided coverage CL of rows 16 and 17 and of bound combination, the upstreams compliance needs ('with' conditions), the denominator fields it must declare and whether it is a counting quantity (exact intervals). Read only by contracts/design.py. Initial default [Proposal]: frozen only after physics review by a reviewer the maintainer names (OQ-05); until then every pass is reported as provisional. The minimum-uncertainty numbers are placeholders chosen for this initial default, not reviewed values. The four ADQ-07 rows (survival-probability with its data validation, tracking-selection-efficiency, rigidity-scale-offset, low-rigidity-bias) join with M2 (OQ-09).

hash_exclusions.$comment: MAT-05: keys (at any depth) removed before the canonical content hash of a recomputed design report is compared with the one an H4 record approved: the review-axis fields this approval sets, the baseline state, and the rendering's omissions; frozen with this table's version (the report's provenance.created is outside the compared payload)

species.$comment: charge number and mass (GeV) of the species a denominator may name; masses from PDG RPP 2024 (proton, electron, muon, charged pion and kaon) and the alpha-particle and deuteron masses of CODATA 2018; tool_name is the species name the plugin's PID tools read; mass_number is A (0 for leptons and mesons)

sources.detector-design-principles: skills/hep-detector/references/detector-design-principles.md (fidelity ladder analytic -> toy -> Geant4 -> test beam)
sources.charge-confusion: skills/hep-detector/references/charge-confusion.md (the Gaussian core is only a lower bound; far from MDR tails dominate)
sources.tracking-and-vertexing: skills/hep-detector/references/tracking-and-vertexing.md (PDG fit form of the scattering term; Gluckstern)
sources.spec: detector system design spec 1.0 (2026-10-23), section 6.3 ADQ-05

momentum-resolution-core.f1_nature: optimistic only above the crossover rigidity (measurement-dominated: ideal Gaussian point errors, uniform field, no alignment errors, no energy loss or nuclear interactions, no pattern-recognition failures); an estimate below it (PDG 0.016 GeV coefficient, uniform material, no Highland log term: about 20% to 50% above the best fit)
momentum-resolution-core.rationale: tracker_resolution.py is a design estimate, not a track fit; compliance needs F3 with response tails, alignment and material terms as declared inputs

maximum-detectable-rigidity.f1_nature: optimistic for the exact fit (in the high-rigidity regime F1 agrees with the best fit); with Gluckstern (N < 10) the intrinsic term is too large and the MDR too low, so that operation is an estimate with the Gluckstern bias in its uncertainty
maximum-detectable-rigidity.rationale: by definition the core resolution; the denominator declares the definition (intrinsic term only, or total resolution reaching 100%)

charge-confusion-rate.f1_nature: optimistic: Gaussian core only, assuming the upstream curvature resolution is itself a lower bound (not below the crossover rigidity) and no curvature offset; rigidity ranges where these fail are outside the contract's validity domain
charge-confusion-rate.rationale: far from the MDR the rate is set by tails from large-angle scattering, nuclear interactions, wrong hit association and secondaries; compliance needs F4 with tails validated by data (at least two routes)

charge-confusion-data-validation.f1_nature: no F1 tool: a data-driven check of the simulated tails (control samples or test beam)
charge-confusion-data-validation.rationale: the 'with tails validated by data' condition of the charge-confusion row as a required upstream (ADQ-02)

calorimeter-energy-resolution.f1_nature: evaluate with design coefficients is optimistic (the constant term excludes leakage, intercalibration and non-uniformity); a fit to measured points is an estimate; the three-term formula describes only the core
calorimeter-energy-resolution.rationale: leakage and non-linearity need simulation; the constant term comes from intercalibration and non-uniformity, which Geant4 does not include automatically

shower-containment.f1_nature: no F1 or F2 tool (capability.unavailable below F4)

pid-separation-power.f1_nature: optimistic: TOF uses only the timing resolution (no momentum, path-length or start-time errors); dE/dx omits the density effect for beta gamma > 4
pid-separation-power.rationale: needs the number of samples and correlations; single and quadrature conventions differ by sqrt(2)

pid-rejection.f1_nature: optimistic: real responses have heavier tails than a Gaussian, and multiplying rejections as if independent overestimates them
pid-rejection.rationale: rejection is set by tails; an optimistic value that misses a >= target is enough to judge non-compliance

geometric-acceptance.f1_nature: optimistic at low rigidity in the straight-line limit, only for apertures on one straight axis
geometric-acceptance.rationale: spectrometer acceptance depends on rigidity, charge sign and source spectrum; compliance needs in-field tracking (F2)

mass-budget.f1_nature: estimate with per-item uncertainty (an arithmetic sum)
mass-budget.rationale: not a physics performance prediction; engineering review belongs to the review axis

power-budget.f1_nature: estimate with per-item uncertainty (an arithmetic sum)
power-budget.rationale: not a physics performance prediction; engineering review belongs to the review axis

channel-count-budget.f1_nature: estimate with per-item uncertainty (an arithmetic sum)
channel-count-budget.rationale: not a physics performance prediction; engineering review belongs to the review axis

data-rate-budget.f1_nature: estimate with per-item uncertainty (an arithmetic sum)
data-rate-budget.rationale: not a physics performance prediction; engineering review belongs to the review axis

expected-precision.f1_nature: combined along the chain (CMB-*); a chain assembled from F1 charge confusion is optimistic and can only exclude
expected-precision.rationale: every input in the chain reaches its own compliance threshold (F4 plus data validation for charge confusion); required upstreams are declared by the tool contract

survival-probability.f1_nature: estimate dominated by the inelastic cross-section uncertainty (survival_feeddown.py); the material map is counted separately
survival-probability.rationale: nuclear-interaction survival and fragmentation feed-down (ADQ-07); compliance needs simulation with the material map and a data check of the survival

survival-data-validation.f1_nature: no F1 tool: survival measured with the instrument's own data (e.g. interacting versus non-interacting samples)
survival-data-validation.rationale: the data condition of the survival row (ADQ-02)

tracking-selection-efficiency.f1_nature: no F1 tool (capability.unavailable below F4): pattern recognition and nuclear-interaction losses need simulation and data
tracking-selection-efficiency.rationale: tracking and selection efficiency including pattern recognition and interaction losses (ADQ-07)

rigidity-scale-offset.f1_nature: no F1 tool: the curvature offset from weak alignment modes and field-map residuals is measured in flight; propagate_scale_distortion.py turns it into nuisances of the expected-precision chain
rigidity-scale-offset.rationale: rigidity scale and curvature offset (ADQ-07); a design can only plan the calibration that measures it

low-rigidity-bias.f1_nature: rigidity bias from energy loss and the mass hypothesis at low rigidity; no shipped F1 tool

material-budget.f1_nature: estimate: the sum of the declared material along the track (measuring layers, passive material and the services other subsystems add)
material-budget.rationale: CHN-14: coupling between subsystems as an evaluation whose parameter_refs connect them

hadronic-energy-resolution.f1_nature: hadronic calorimeter energy resolution: no F1 tool for hadron showers (capability.unavailable below F4)
hadronic-energy-resolution.rationale: listed so a design records it as capability.unavailable instead of estimating a number (PRN-07, EXB-02)

trigger-efficiency.f1_nature: trigger efficiency for the signal: no design tool (capability.unavailable below F4)
trigger-efficiency.rationale: listed so a design records it as capability.unavailable instead of estimating a number (PRN-07, EXB-02)

pileup-robustness.f1_nature: performance degradation under pileup: no design tool (capability.unavailable below F4)
pileup-robustness.rationale: listed so a design records it as capability.unavailable instead of estimating a number (PRN-07, EXB-02)

calorimeter-calibration-plan.f1_nature: a calibration plan for the constant term (intercalibration and non-uniformity) with the samples it uses; reviewed at F4; no F1 tool
calorimeter-calibration-plan.rationale: the 'with' condition of the calorimeter energy-resolution row (ADQ-02) as figures of merit with thresholds

calorimeter-constant-term-measurement.f1_nature: the constant term measured with prototype or in-situ data; no F1 tool
calorimeter-constant-term-measurement.rationale: the 'with' condition of the calorimeter energy-resolution row (ADQ-02) as figures of merit with thresholds
